categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Adds script evaluation trace APIs and hooks directly to libbitcoinkernel (`src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.{h,cpp}`, `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h`, and kernel unit tests).
categories.rationale: The PR adds an optional build-time execution tracing API to libbitcoinkernel to support script debuggers and fine-grained interpreter state analysis. While it provides clear value and a working use case demonstrated by the author's proof-of-concept debugger and community tooling, it is an optional debugging tool rather than core library functionality, making it reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Despite the Validation label and edits to `src/script/interpreter.cpp`, the category explicitly excludes PRs whose primary subject is the kernel API when they do not substantively change validation logic or rules.
categories.rationale: The PR belongs to kernel rather than validation. Macro hooks inserted into `EvalScript` compile to no-op stubs in default builds and do not alter validity rules, consensus invariants, or chainstate behavior.
